lines.zh: 我的蹄子把腐叶翻起来。
lines.en: My hooves turn up the matted leaves.
Nose to the ground, I smell as I go.
I root along the way for buried tubers.
My stiff bristles scrape past the bushes.
I walk heavy, and the grass lies down.
My tusks clack against the branches.

lines.zh: 我领着这一群往低处走。
lines.en: I lead this sounder toward lower ground.
Mud spatters across my back.
I step around that patch of loose soil.
These short legs still make good speed.
I wade through a shallow stream.
There is beetroot smell up ahead.
I stop and root the soil twice.

lines.zh: 走在最后的小猪别掉队。
lines.en: Little pig at the back, keep up.

lines.zh: 我绕着茶田走，避开那些嫩芽。
lines.en: I walk around the tea field and spare the young shoots.

lines.zh: 鼻子一拱，土里翻出条蚯蚓。
lines.en: One nudge of my snout turns up an earthworm.
I sharpen my tusks on the bark.
Belly on the ground, it is cooler.
A fly keeps circling my ear.
I let out a long grunting sigh.
The mud pit is warm from the morning sun.
I listen to what moves in the woods.
One tail flick, and the mosquitoes go.
I am thinking about raw boarchop.
I am chewing a length of tree root.
My kin are rooting soil far off.
I scrape my bristles on the bark.
The wind carries my scent away.
This nest of grass suits me fine.
I look up with mud still on my snout.

lines.zh: 我在灶屋外闻了一下午的味。
lines.en: I spent the afternoon sniffing at the kitchen door.

lines.zh: 有人倒了淘米水，我全喝了。
lines.en: Someone poured out rice water, and I drank it all.
You smell faintly of carrots.

lines.zh: 你站这么近，是想喂我吗。
lines.en: Standing this close, do you mean to feed me?

lines.zh: 我看见你腰上挂的袋子。
lines.en: I see the bag hanging at your waist.
Your boots are caked with fresh mud.
When your hand moves, my eyes lock on.
If you raise a hand, I step back.
You are shorter than trees, taller than mushrooms.
I can tell you brought no beetroot.
There is firelight in your eyes.
I am waiting for you to set it down.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住了我的背。
lines.en: Your shadow covers my whole back.

lines.zh: 你身上有一点火的味道。
lines.en: There is a trace of fire on your clothes.
Who touched my back?
That one actually stung.
I am bleeding, truly bleeding.
Do not make me turn around.

lines.zh: 我的皮厚，可也不是石头。
lines.en: My hide is thick, but it is not stone.
It hurts; now I will root at you.
Whoever hit me, step out.
My forelegs are starting to give.
I will plaster this wound with mud.
I grunt once and back behind the tree.
A carrot. I can smell it.

lines.zh: 你举那么高，我鼻子碰不到。
lines.en: That high up, my snout cannot reach it.
I will follow this carrot anywhere.
Potatoes work too; I am not picky.
You wiggle a beetroot in front of me.
My drool is dripping into the mud.
Do not run; I will chase you.
That smell makes me forget my tusks.

lines.zh: 你把胡萝卜举高，我踮起蹄子。
lines.en: You raise the carrot high, and I rise onto my hooves.
One small bite will not cost you much.

lines.zh: 我闭着眼也能找到甜菜。
lines.en: I could find beetroot with my eyes shut.
Put it down, and I will come over.
I can tell it was pulled this morning.
Is that the whole root in your hand?

lines.zh: 你手里那根胡萝卜，我认出来了。
lines.en: I know that carrot in your hand.

lines.zh: 那股甜味一飘，我鼻子就抬了。
lines.en: The sweet smell drifts over and my snout lifts.
You knocked my snout sideways.
This bulk of mine can take a bump.
Mind the tusks; do not come too close.

lines.zh: 我挪开身子，你从这边过。
lines.en: I shift my bulk; pass on this side.

lines.zh: 你的靴跟压在我的后蹄上。
lines.en: Your heel came down on my hind hoof.
That collision sent soil flying.
I squeeze past you sideways.
Do not shove me; my temper is short.
My back is as hard as stone.
We knock together with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 我给她拱出最软的一块土。
lines.en: I rooted out the softest patch of soil for her.
We press our snouts together.
The bristles on her back are darker than mine.

lines.zh: 我守在她睡的那丛草外。
lines.en: I keep watch outside the grass where she sleeps.
Next spring there will be a few more piglets.
I chase the flies away from her.
We search for beetroot side by side.

lines.zh: 她拱一下土，我就跟过去。
lines.en: She roots once, and I trot after her.
I let her roll in the mud pit first.
We sleep side by side, back to back.
I pick up the fallen carrot with my teeth.
I clamp this thing in my jaw.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西先归我的牙。
lines.en: Anything dropped goes to my teeth first.
I flip it over with my snout.
There is still half a potato in my mouth.
I rooted for ages before I got it up.
I will bury this under the tree root.
Whoever dropped it, I bite first.

lines.zh: 我嘴里含着它拱回窝里。
lines.en: Holding it in my jaw, I root my way home.
I will take what is in the mud too.

lines.zh: 那只狼在打小猪的主意。
lines.en: That wolf is eyeing the piglets.
Strange metal smell just reached me.
Someone stepped into my territory.
Something is moving the grass over there.
I turn toward the smell of blood.
I put the piglets behind my body.
Those eyes are fixed on my sounder.
I lower my head and point my tusks.
Something is digging up my food roots.
I have marked exactly where it stands.
My grunt drops low, a warning only.
I paw the ground twice with a forehoof.
I will not retreat, and you will not pass.
My tusks can reach you from here.
Once I charge, I cannot stop.

lines.zh: 你先动蹄，我就知道要冲。
lines.en: The moment you move, I start the charge.

lines.zh: 鬃毛从脖子一直竖到屁股。
lines.en: My bristles rise from neck to rump.
I lower my neck until it nearly drags.
You have one step left to change your mind.
My hooves have churned the soil loose.
My tusk rips upward from below.
I drive my whole head into your legs.
That blow threw soil into the air.
My teeth sink in and stay sunk.

lines.zh: 你那块木板挡不住我的颅骨。
lines.en: That plank of yours cannot stop my skull.

lines.zh: 你被獠牙挑得滚了半圈。
lines.en: My tusk tips you half a turn over.
After the hit, I shake my head.

lines.zh: 这一下是给那群小猪的。
lines.en: That one was for the piglets.

lines.zh: 我压过去，用全身的重量。
lines.en: I lean in with all my weight.

lines.zh: 撞空了，我自己打了个趔趄。
lines.en: I missed and stumbled over my own feet.

lines.zh: 刺丛一响，我整头钻出来。
lines.en: The thorns rustle and I push through headfirst.
I was born with these tusks already.
This wood belongs to my sounder now.
I know this smell of turned earth.
My first rooting was one mouthful of root.
There is still grass for me in the shade.
I shake the stiff bristles on my back.
My own kind call from somewhere far.
This damp air is good for fattening up.
First I will find a mud pit to roll in.
Fire! One touch and my bristles curl.
After that fall, all four hooves are numb.

lines.zh: 水进了鼻子，我拼命扑腾。
lines.en: Water fills my snout and I thrash hard.

lines.zh: 炸药味冲进鼻子，耳朵响。
lines.en: Gunpowder smell floods my nose; my ears ring.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西卡在我肩胛里。
lines.en: Something sharp is stuck between my shoulders.
The wound glows purple, and that is wrong.
Three days without rooting up a single root.
The lightning dropped me to my knees.
No ground left; my four hooves kick nothing.
